changelog: - **Server components now bind the tenant context before reading data** (#2356, epic #2349). The tenant-isolation middleware only scopes a Prisma query when a request has bound its org via `withTenantScope`/`runWithOrg`; API routes do this, but three server-rendered pages queried Prisma directly and so, under `MT_ENFORCE_ISOLATION`, read across tenants: the admin dashboard counted and listed **every** tenant's mentees/mentors/mentorships (surfaced on a preview marketing org whose dashboard showed the internship tenant's people while its own user list correctly showed one); the project detail page fetched a project by id with no org filter (a signed-in cross-tenant IDOR — an admin could open another tenant's private project, roster and join requests); and the re-engagement pool relied on a hand-rolled, not-fail-closed org filter. All three now bind the caller's org (`src/app/admin/page.tsx`, `src/app/projects/[id]/page.tsx`, `src/app/admin/re-engagement/page.tsx`), and a new isolation e2e pins the dashboard in both directions. No behaviour change while the flag is off; anonymous access to the public project showcase is unchanged. The cross-tenant public-project listing on `/projects` is tracked separately for host→org scoping.
